name: test-engineering
description: Framework-neutral test engineering plugin for codebase-aware test inventory, coverage gap review, redundancy review, function-to-test confidence grading, test design, and monolithic test decomposition.

interface.longDescription: Understand code structure, inventory existing tests, find coverage gaps and redundancy, grade function-to-test confidence, design missing tests, and decompose monolithic test cases across common project types.
defaultPrompt: Use $using-test-engineering to review test coverage for this feature.
Use $function-test-grader to grade functions against existing tests.
Use $test-monolith-decomposer to split broad tests safely.
